result.description: Compact desktop audio interface for independent podcasters and live streamers, featuring 4-in/5-out routing, dual low-noise mic preamps, 24-bit/96 kHz conversion, and software-controlled loopback for multitrack capture. Designed for USB-C connection with bus-powered operation and a tactile monitor knob for quick level adjustments.
